text: McDonald's Corporation is a listed company: its common stock trades under the symbol MCD on the New York Stock Exchange, and 710,398,642 shares were outstanding as of 31 January 2026, with an estimated 5,100,000 shareholders of record and beneficial owners.
short: McDonald's Corporation is listed on the NYSE (MCD); widely held.

source.name: McDonald's Corporation Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025 (SEC EDGAR)
source.quote: The number of shares outstanding of the registrant’s common stock as of January 31, 2026: 710,398,642 .

additionalSources.name: McDonald's Corporation Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025, Part II Item 5 (SEC EDGAR)
additionalSources.quote: The Company’s common stock trades under the symbol MCD and is listed on the New York Stock Exchange in the U.S. The number of shareholders of record and beneficial owners of the Company’s common stock as of January 31, 2026 was estimated to be 5,100,000.
